title: Rules by supreme court.
bodyText: The supreme court may from time to time, by general rules, prescribe forms for carrying section 604-13 into effect, and make all other needful regulations.
bodyHtml:
§604-15  Rules by supreme court.  The supreme court may from time to time, by general rules, prescribe forms for carrying section 604-13 into effect, and make all other needful regulations. [L 1868, p 21; RL 1925, §2282; RL 1935, §3772; RL 1945, §9682; RL 1955, §216-13; HRS §604-15]

 

Revision Note

 

  Reference to repealed §604-14, deleted.

 

Cross References
